scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: Ama tells a story about sharing. Which action matches that theme?
The answer is: Shares food with a neighbour. A good cultural story connects people and shared values.
Watch and read: Ama asks: Imagine you are acting as a friendly shopkeeper. What helps the audience understand?
The answer is: Use matching words and actions. Role-play uses speech, actions and character feelings.
